rows.desc: root: 40-unit all-treatment burst (90% converting) interleaved into one day, with contract: no causal claim in 20 seeds (invalid_experiment)
same burst without a contract: never a causal claim
50-unit burst without contract: outcomes recorded (association_only shows the guards missed it)
6-unit burst with contract (expected escape rate 1/64): outcomes recorded
A/A with contract: assignment verified in every seed and causal false positives at most 3 of 20
true effect 20% -> 30% with contract: difference_detected and causal in at least 18 of 20
30/70 split, true effect, contract: verified and difference_detected
package declares a salt that did not assign the arms: invalid_experiment, never causal
malformed contract or a contract on an observational package: refused, exit 2
non-ASCII unit ids: the documented UTF-8 rule verifies them
OBS: with no true effect, 25%% of converting control units missing from the assignment log, contract present: outcomes (the contract checks arms of present units, not missing ones)
